related.title: TESS 系外行星巡天
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付光變、基線、深度、半徑比及未排除的假陽性清單。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver light curve,baseline,depth,radius ratio and unresolved false-positive scenarios.
related.difference: 計算鄰星混光對凌日深度的稀釋，規劃質心與孔徑比較驗證。
related.differenceEn: Calculate transit-depth dilution from a neighbouring star and plan centroid/aperture checks.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 算深度、ppm 與平方根，畫面積比和半徑比的差別。
從觀測損失 0.008×1000=8 單位回推目標深度，再與公式核對。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate depth,ppm and square root,illustrating area ratio versus radius ratio.
Infer target depth from observed loss 0.008×1000=8 units and cross-check the formula.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.

related.title: IXPE X 射線偏振探測
related.why: 用兩課的可觀察驗收條件比較模型邊界：交付光變、基線、深度、半徑比及未排除的假陽性清單。
related.whyEn: Compare model boundaries using observable acceptance criteria: Deliver light curve,baseline,depth,radius ratio and unresolved false-positive scenarios.
related.difference: 由合成 Stokes 參數估算偏振比例，辨識正值偏差及儀器調變校準。
related.differenceEn: Estimate polarization fraction from synthetic Stokes parameters and recognize positive bias and modulation calibration.
related.transfer: 保留單位與邊界條件，僅轉移可證明相容的驗證方法。
related.transferEn: Retain units and boundary conditions; transfer only demonstrably compatible verification methods.
practice: 算深度、ppm 與平方根，畫面積比和半徑比的差別。
先求 Q/U 向量長 50，再除 I，分開小數與百分比。
比較兩個模型的輸入、誤差與驗收條件，記錄不能沿用的假設。
practiceEn: Calculate depth,ppm and square root,illustrating area ratio versus radius ratio.
Calculate Q/U vector length 50,then divide by I and distinguish fraction from percentage.
Compare inputs, errors, and criteria; document assumptions that cannot be transferred.
